object_kinds.label: Creature
object_kinds.description: A persistent creature identity without a stronger product-specific world-object kind. Peer to Threat, NPC, and PlayerCharacter; not a superclass.

object_kinds.label: Threat
object_kinds.description: A persistent Threat world-object identity. Independent from any contextual dnd5e:threatens relationship and from mechanics attachment.

object_kinds.label: NPC
object_kinds.description: A persistent non-player character world-object identity. May carry mechanics without becoming a Threat.

object_kinds.label: Player Character
object_kinds.description: A persistent player-character world-object identity. Mechanics authority is a later plug-in; this kind does not imply a StatblockRevision.

object_kinds.label: Location
object_kinds.description: A campaign place that can be referenced by identity.

object_kinds.label: Faction
object_kinds.description: A persistent organized group or affiliation.

object_kinds.label: Encounter
object_kinds.description: A bounded prepared, potential, historical, or active play situation. It is not synonymous with combat.

object_kinds.label: Item
object_kinds.description: A persistent in-world item or object identity. It may represent equipment, an artifact, device, consumable, possession, mundane object, or another object tracked by durable identity. The kind alone does not imply magical status, ownership, mechanics, inventory state, or an external mechanics resource.

object_kinds.label: Mystery
object_kinds.description: A persistent unresolved mystery, investigative question, secret, unexplained phenomenon, or narrative uncertainty tracked by identity. Mystery identity is independent from epistemic standing: a mystery object may be canonical knowledge while candidate explanations remain speculative.

object_kinds.label: Group
object_kinds.description: A persistent collection of people, creatures, objects, or other participants treated as a coherent group, without asserting the stronger semantics of a Faction or Party. Peer to Faction and Party; not a superclass or subclass of either.

object_kinds.label: Party
object_kinds.description: A persistent adventuring party, expedition party, or comparable party-level identity whose membership is tracked separately from the identities of its individual participants. Does not imply Faction membership, Group identity, or automatic membership of player characters.

object_kinds.label: Event
object_kinds.description: A persistent fictional occurrence or occurrence-shaped world identity. Whether it occurred, is occurring, is proposed, is provisional, or is retracted is governed by assertion metadata and temporal knowledge — not by the object kind itself. Distinct from Encounter, Session, and fictional-time anchors.

predicates.label: Located at
predicates.description: Subject is situated at the location for the asserted context.

predicates.label: Member of
predicates.description: Subject is an asserted member of a faction, group, or party. Membership does not establish identity hierarchy or imply reciprocal membership assertions.

predicates.label: Participates in
predicates.description: Subject participates in an Encounter or Event. Participation does not imply membership, presence at every location associated with that event, or fictional-time derivation from session references.

predicates.label: Threatens
predicates.description: Subject poses a contextual threat to object. This does not define dnd5e:threat, mechanics eligibility, hostility permanence, or an attack assertion.

predicates.label: Located in
predicates.description: Subject is spatially or contextually inside a Location. This is intentionally distinct from located_at; no automatic rename or inference exists between them.

predicates.label: Contains
predicates.description: Subject spatially or structurally contains object for the asserted context. It does not imply membership, ownership, or an automatically synthesized inverse part_of/located_in assertion.

predicates.label: Part of
predicates.description: Subject is a structural constituent or sub-location of object. This is not membership and does not synthesize an inverse contains assertion.

predicates.label: Leads to
predicates.description: A Location provides a directional route, passage, or topological connection to another Location. This is not causal causes/results_in.

predicates.label: Near
predicates.description: Subject is asserted to be spatially near object. No reciprocal edge is automatically synthesized.

predicates.label: South of
predicates.description: Subject Location is spatially south of object Location.

predicates.label: Travels to
predicates.description: Subject moves, or is moved, toward/to a Location in the asserted context. This does not imply that the subject currently remains there.

predicates.label: Displaced from
predicates.description: Subject has been displaced from a Location. The predicate carries the displacement relation but does not invent an exact fictional-time anchor.

predicates.label: Occurs at
predicates.description: An Event or Encounter is spatially associated with a Location. Whether the occurrence is canonical, provisional, proposed, played, retracted, or temporally anchored remains assertion metadata / fictional-time authority.

predicates.label: Present at
predicates.description: Subject is present at a Location, Encounter, or Event for the asserted context. Presence does not imply participation.

predicates.label: Attacks
predicates.description: Subject attacks object in the asserted context. An attack does not imply persistent Threat identity, a threatens assertion, or mechanics attachment.

predicates.label: Causes
predicates.description: Subject is asserted to causally produce or contribute to object/result. No transitive closure or automatic causal chain derivation.

predicates.label: Pursues
predicates.description: Subject actively pursues, investigates, seeks, or attempts to obtain/resolve object as asserted by the source relation. This does not imply travel, attack, ownership, or successful resolution.

predicates.label: Aware of
predicates.description: Subject has awareness of object. Awareness is weaker than a claim of substantive knowledge.

predicates.label: Knows about
predicates.description: Subject has asserted knowledge concerning object. Epistemic/canon standing of the graph assertion remains assertion metadata.

predicates.label: Suspects
predicates.description: Subject suspects something concerning object. This does not make the target object itself speculative or non-canonical.

predicates.label: Carries
predicates.description: Subject physically carries or transports an Item in the asserted context.

predicates.label: Holds
predicates.description: Subject holds an Item in the asserted context. This is not equivalent to durable ownership.

predicates.label: Possesses
predicates.description: Subject possesses or has custody/control of an Item. Possession does not imply ownership.

predicates.label: Owns
predicates.description: Subject has an asserted ownership relation to object.

predicates.label: Commands
predicates.description: Subject has asserted command authority over object.

predicates.label: Leads
predicates.description: Subject leads an organized Faction, Group, or Party.

predicates.label: Recruits for
predicates.description: Subject recruits on behalf of an organized Faction, Group, or Party.

predicates.label: Serves
predicates.description: Subject serves a person or organized collective.

predicates.label: Allied with
predicates.description: Subject has an explicitly asserted alliance with object. No automatic reciprocal edge.

predicates.label: Cooperates with
predicates.description: Subject explicitly cooperates with object in the asserted context. No automatic reciprocal edge.

predicates.label: Works with
predicates.description: Subject works/collaborates with object in the asserted context. No automatic reciprocal edge.

predicates.label: Rivals
predicates.description: Subject has an asserted rivalry with object. No automatic reciprocal edge.

predicates.label: Trusts
predicates.description: Subject trusts object in the asserted context. No reciprocity.

predicates.label: Parent of
predicates.description: Subject has an asserted parent relationship to object. No automatic child_of inverse.

predicates.label: Associated with
predicates.description: Source explicitly asserts a weak association between subject and object without claiming identity, membership, location, causation, ownership, or another stronger relation. Not a fallback for unknown predicates.
